scope: Local configured webhook HTTP adapter and durable inbox only

conditions.database: PostgreSQL 17.11 portable Windows x64, isolated synthetic database
conditions.webhookTransport: Actual local Node HTTP server with signed synthetic payloads
conditions.authorization: Controlled live-access fixture; actual authorized binding registry and invalidation methods
conditions.analysis: Actual durable coordinator with a controlled analysis runner and current-ref resolver
conditions.rehearsalHelper: Protected local helper; credential loaded only into child environment

checks: Unknown signed installation has no owner routing authority
Same-context-SHA PR update receives fresh immutable analysis identity and leaves old snapshot readable
Replay is deduplicated and force-push/out-of-order PR base changes resolve current server refs
Explicit reconciliation retains the requested display branch
Verified removal invokes actual epoch/cancellation purge fence; late private completion cannot resurrect snapshots/jobs
Durable PostgreSQL inbox survives reopening with delivery deduplication and owner-scoped status
Owned database server stopped after tests; credentials were not printed
resolvedFinding: First live run found a double-close PostgreSQL pool defect. Inbox close is now idempotent; all four tests passed on rerun.
limitations: No external GitHub App account or actual GitHub webhook delivery
No hosted multi-process webhook ingress or persisted installation registry rehearsal
Refresh uses bounded full analysis; incremental efficiency is unproven
This evidence does not authorize or enable a beta or intelligence rollout
